start_gcode: M82 ; set extruder to absolute mode
G28 X0 Y0 ; home X and Y
G1 Z30 F{machine_max_speed_z[0]*60} ; move Z a bit down to not blow on the bed edge while heating
G1 X10 F3900 ; let some space on x to prevent the filament cooling exhaust from beeing blocked by the servo motor
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; wait for bed temp
M106 S80 ; turn on fan to prevent air nozzle melt while heating up
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; wait for extruder temp
M107 ; start with the fan off
G28 X0 ; goto X home again
G92 E0 ; zero the extruded length
G1 Z0.2 F360 ; move plattform upwards
; extrude material next to the plattform (comment or remove following lines to disable)
G1 F180 E20 ; extrude some material next to the plattform
G92 E0 ; zero the extruded length
G1 E-[retraction_length] F{retraction_speed[0]*60} ; do a filament retract
G92 E0 ; zero the extruded length again
G1 X5 F3900 ; move sideways to get rid of that string
G1 E[retraction_length] F{retraction_speed[0]*60} ; do a filament deretract with retract parameters
G92 E0 ; zero the extruded length again
; draw intro line (comment or remove following lines to disable)
G1 X30 E5 F700 ; draw intro line
G92 E0 ; zero the extruded length
G1 E-[retraction_length] F{retraction_speed[0]*60} ; do a filament retract
G1 X40 Z2.0 ; move away from the introline
G92 E0 ; zero the extruded length again
G1 E[retraction_length] F{retraction_speed[0]*60} ; do a filament deretract with retract parameters
end_gcode: M104 S0 ; turn off extruder heating
M140 S0 ; turn off bed heating
G0 Z+0.5 ; move Z up a tiny bit
G0 X135 Y105 F{machine_max_speed_x[0]*60} ; move extruder to center position
G0 Z190.5 F{machine_max_speed_z[0]*60} ; lower the plattform to Z min

start_gcode: M17 Z0.3 ; lower the z-motor current
M17 X0.65 Y1.2 Z0.6 ; reset motor current to default
M960 S5 P1 ; turn on logo lamp
;M211 X0 Y0 Z0 ; turn off soft endstop to prevent protential logic problem
M982.2 S1 ; turn on cog noise reduction
G28 Z P0 T140; home z with low precision,permit 300deg temperature
M211 X0 Y0 Z0 ;turn off soft endstop
M620 S[initial_no_support_extruder]A   ; switch material if AMS exist
M109 S250 ;set nozzle to common flush temp
G1 E50 F200 ; lower extrusion speed to avoid clog
;===== prepare print temperature and material end =====
M412 S1 ;  ===turn on  filament runout detection===
M620.3 W1; === turn on filament tangle detection===
M983 F{outer_wall_volumetric_speed/2.4} A0.3 H[nozzle_diameter]; cali dynamic extrusion compensation
M983 F{outer_wall_volumetric_speed/2.4} A0.3 H[nozzle_diameter]; cali dynamic extrusion compensation
M984 A0.1 E1 S1 F{outer_wall_volumetric_speed/2.4} H[nozzle_diameter]
M623 ; end of "draw extrinsic para cali paint"
M104 S170 ; prepare to wipe nozzle
M106 S255 ; turn on fan (G28 has turn off fan)
M211 S; push soft endstop status
M211 X0 Y0 Z0 ;turn off Z axis endstop
M104 S170 ; set temp down to heatbed acceptable
G28 Z P0 T300; home z with low precision,permit 300deg temperature
G0 X128 Y261 F20000  ; move to exposed steel surface
G0 Z-1.01 F1200      ; stop the nozzle
;G0 X128 Y261 F20000  ; move to exposed steel surface
G0 Z-1.01 F1200      ; stop the nozzle
M106 S255 ; turn on fan (G28 has turn off fan)
M106 S0 ; turn off fan , too noisy
G29 A1 X{first_layer_print_min[0]} Y{first_layer_print_min[1]} I{first_layer_print_size[0]} J{first_layer_print_size[1]}
;========turn off light and wait extrude temperature =============
;===== for Textured PEI Plate , lower the nozzle as the nozzle was touching topmost of the texture when homing ==
G29.1 Z{-0.02} ; for Textured PEI Plate
M960 S1 P0 ; turn off laser
M960 S2 P0 ; turn off laser
M106 P2 S0 ; turn off big fan
M106 P3 S0 ; turn off chamber fan
M975 S1 ; turn on mech mode supression
M211 X0 Y0 Z0 ;turn off soft endstop
M1007 S1 ; turn on mass estimation
end_gcode: G392 S0 ;turn off nozzle clog detect
M400 ; wait for buffer to clear
G1 Z{max_layer_z + 0.5} F900 ; lower z a little
G1 X0 Y{first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower[1]} F18000 ; move to safe pos
G1 X-13.0 F3000 ; move to safe pos
M991 S0 P-1 ;end timelapse at safe pos
M106 P2 S0 ; turn off remote part cooling fan
M106 P3 S0 ; turn off chamber cooling fan
M17 Z0.4 ; lower z motor current to reduce impact if there is something in the bottom
;M17 X0.8 Y0.8 Z0.5 ; lower motor current to 45% power

start_gcode: ;===== turn on the HB fan & MC board fan =================
M104 S75 ;set extruder temp to turn on the HB fan and prevent filament oozing from nozzle
M710 A1 S255 ;turn on MC fan by default(P1S)
M17 Z0.4 ; lower the z-motor current
G380 S2 Z30 F300 ; G380 is same as G38; lower the hotbed , to prevent the nozzle is below the hotbed
M17 X1.2 Y1.2 Z0.75 ; reset motor current to default
M960 S5 P1 ; turn on logo lamp
M221 X0 Y0 Z0 ; turn off soft endstop to prevent protential logic problem
G29.1 Z{+0.0} ; clear z-trim value first
M204 S10000 ; init ACC set to 10m/s^2
;=============turn on fans to prevent PLA jamming=================
M106 P2 S100 ; turn on big fan ,to cool down toolhead
M620 S[initial_extruder]A   ; switch material if AMS exist
M412 S1 ; ===turn on filament runout detection===
M109 S250 ;set nozzle to common flush temp
M109 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder]-20} ; drop nozzle temp, make filament shink a bit
G1 X65 F15000; shake to put down garbage
G1 X165 F15000; wipe and shake
;===== prepare print temperature and material end =====
G1 X100 F18000 ; first wipe mouth
G0 X135 Y253 F20000  ; move to exposed steel surface edge
G28 Z P0 T300; home z with low precision,permit 300deg temperature
G1 X100 F5000; second wipe mouth
G0 X128 Y261 Z-1.5 F20000  ; move to exposed steel surface and stop the nozzle
M104 S140 ; set temp down to heatbed acceptable
M106 S255 ; turn on fan (G28 has turn off fan)
M221 S; push soft endstop status
M221 Z0 ;turn off Z axis endstop
M109 S140 ; wait nozzle temp down to heatbed acceptable
;G28 ; home again after hard wipe mouth
M106 S0 ; turn off fan , too noisy
G29 A X{first_layer_print_min[0]} Y{first_layer_print_min[1]} I{first_layer_print_size[0]} J{first_layer_print_size[1]}
M975 S1 ; turn on vibration supression
;=============turn on fans to prevent PLA jamming=================
M106 P2 S100 ; turn on big fan ,to cool down toolhead
M104 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder]} ; set extrude temp earlier, to reduce wait time
G1 X18.0 Y1.0 Z0.8 F18000;Move to start position
;===== for Textured PEI Plate , lower the nozzle as the nozzle was touching topmost of the texture when homing ==
G29.1 Z-0.04 ; for Textured PEI Plate
;========turn off light and wait extrude temperature =============
M106 P2 S0 ; turn off big fan
M106 P3 S0 ; turn off chamber fan
M975 S1 ; turn on mech mode supression
end_gcode: M400 ; wait for buffer to clear
G1 Z{max_layer_z + 0.5} F900 ; lower z a little
G1 X65 Y245 F12000 ; move to safe pos
M106 P2 S0 ; turn off remote part cooling fan
M106 P3 S0 ; turn off chamber cooling fan
M622.1 S1 ; for prev firmware, default turned on
M991 S0 P-1 ;end smooth timelapse at safe pos
M400 S3 ;wait for last picture to be taken
M17 Z0.4 ; lower z motor current to reduce impact if there is something in the bottom
M17 X0.8 Y0.8 Z0.5 ; lower motor current to 45% power
